_source: Helen Edgar's ask, 2026-11-11: "A map of your yurt and its rooms ... with a 'you are here'". Every way through and every place is where it stands in the yurt on Cel Street (cel-in-faery-yurt.js), measured round from the far wall the way a clock's hand goes, seen from above; tools/make-yurt-map.py checks every way's angle against that file, so the map and the room cannot disagree. Degrees: 0 is the far wall, 90 the right-hand side as you come in, 180 the door, -90 (270) the left-hand side.

places.name: the door out to the campgrounds
the regulation nook and its egg chair
her own page, on the far wall
the stove, with the fly agarics round it
